review.tagline: High-level deep learning library on PyTorch for vision, text, tabular and recommenders
review.summary: fastai is a Python deep learning library built on PyTorch. It offers high-level APIs that train image classifiers, segmentation, text sentiment, tabular and recommendation models in about 5 lines, on top of layered lower-level components for researchers. Core pieces include a data block API, a two-way callback system and an optimizer refactored into small composable parts.
review.audience: Python practitioners and researchers training deep learning models with PyTorch
strengths: Layered API: 5-line high-level training down to low-level building blocks
Two-way callbacks can modify data, model or optimizer at any point in training
Docs are runnable notebooks, with a free course and a book
Migration guides for plain PyTorch, Ignite, Lightning and Catalyst
weaknesses: Jupyter on Windows forces num_workers to 0, making vision training much slower
Covers classic deep learning domains; README does not mention LLM or diffusion workflows
README advises installing PyTorch separately before fastai
GPU memory and RAM requirements are not stated
